description: This file defines the PHP class `CleanRoomsMLClient` within the namespace `Aws\CleanRoomsML`. The class extends `AwsClient` and includes method annotations for interacting with the AWS CleanRooms-ML service, providing a client interface with various API operations related to machine learning models, datasets, and jobs.

classes.name: CleanRoomsMLClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS CleanRooms-ML service, extending AwsClient and providing methods for managing ML models, datasets, and jobs.

methods.name: cancelTrainedModelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels a trained model operation.

methods.name: deleteConfiguredAudienceModelPolicy
methods.description: Deletes a configured audience model policy.

methods.name: deleteConfiguredModelAlgorithmAssociation
methods.description: Deletes a configured model algorithm association.

methods.name: deleteMLInputChannelData
methods.description: Deletes data from an ML input channel.

methods.name: deleteTrainedModelOutput
methods.description: Deletes output of a trained model.

methods.name: getAudienceGenerationJob
methods.description: Retrieves an audience generation job details.

methods.name: getCollaborationConfiguredModelAlgorithmAssociation
methods.description: Gets configuration for collaboration model algorithm association.

methods.name: getCollaborationMLInputChannel
methods.description: Gets collaboration ML input channel details.

methods.name: getConfiguredAudienceModelPolicy
methods.description: Gets the policy of a configured audience model.

methods.name: getConfiguredModelAlgorithm
methods.description: Retrieves details about a configured model algorithm.

methods.name: getConfiguredModelAlgorithmAssociation
methods.description: Gets details of an algorithm association.

methods.name: getTrainedModelInferenceJob
methods.description: Gets an inference job for a trained model.

methods.name: listCollaborationTrainedModelExportJobs
methods.description: Lists collaboration trained model export jobs.

methods.name: listCollaborationTrainedModelInferenceJobs
methods.description: Lists collaboration trained model inference jobs.

methods.name: listTrainedModelInferenceJobs

methods.name: putConfiguredAudienceModelPolicy

methods.name: startTrainedModelExportJob
